description:
I am using these in a hack I'm making.

-Custom Yoshi Egg Coin

Dragon coin, and use the Egg Block to allow Passage when
X Egg Coins are Collected)

Stars

Block that shatters when you pay the amount.
-The Shell Blocks i Made for the Breakable with ... Shell
-A redesigned P-Switch (inspired by TSRPR2 Not the Same
exact Block)
-Redesigned "?" Block and Turn Block
